--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CSH_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CSH_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CSH_ID ORDER BY [FILE_NAME] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT
CSH_ID
,CSH_UUID
,CSH_INS_ID
,CSH_BRN_ID
,CSH_CARD_NUMBER
,CSH_ISSUE_DATE
,CSH_EXPIRY_DATE
,CSH_CARDHOLDER_NAME
,CSH_CREATION_DATE
,CSH_AUTO_RENEWAL
,CSH_STS_ID
,CSH_STATUS_DATE
,CSH_CREATED_BY
,CSH_CREATED_TS
,CSH_UPDATED_BY
,CSH_UPDATED_TS
,CSH_AUDIT_LOG
,CSH_PRS_ID
,CSH_EMB_ID
,CSH_CTS_ID
,CSH_KIT_NUMBER
,CSH_IS_LINKED
,CSH_BCR_ID
,CSH_CARD_NUMBER_ENC
,CSH_CARD_NUMBER_MASKED
,CSH_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL
,CSH_CCL_ID
,CSH_IS_CARD_POSTED
,CSH_PREVIOUS_CSH_ID
,CSH_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
,CSH_LIFE_CYCLE
,CSH_PIN_OFFSET
,CSH_PIN_OFFSET_TS
,CSH_IS_CORPORATE
,CSH_CORPORATE_CIF
,CSH_CORPORATE_NAME
,CSH_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER
,CSH_EMBOSSING_NAME
,CSH_IS_PRIMARY
,CSH_PIN_GENERATED
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records

--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CSH_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CSH_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD;

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CASHCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321
